sentences.text: 2. ShriRajan Tripathi, learned advocate submits that the accused-applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is alleged that the accused-applicant has duped the informant nearly Rs. 6 lakhs on the pretext of investing the money in the shares.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the accused-applicant that the father of the accused-applicant Anil Sharma has given the shop on rent to co-accused Vikas Trivedi proprietor of Banke Bihari Traders.
It is further submitted that no amount is credited in the account of accused-applicant and his name has been figured out during the investigation by co-accused Vikas Trivedi.
The chargesheet has been submitted against the four accused persons though the FIR has been lodged against anonymous persons.
3. Learned A.G.A. submits that the accused-applicant has criminal history of four cases and he has been involved in the present crime as per the statement of co-accused Vikas Trivedi.

It is further Prakhar Sharma Alias Sagar vs State Of U.P. on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40676536/
1 submitted that the offences registered against the accused-applicant are of the same nature where the accused-applicant has committed financial fraud with the persons.
4.

sentences.text: This Court has taken into consideration the rival submission made by the parties.
5. The perusal of the F.I.R. reveals that the informant has lodged the FIR on 14.03.2024 whereby the accused has purchased shares worth of Rs. 6 lakhs through the trading company.
The trading company is of co-accused Vikas Trivedi.
The accused-applicant is named by the co-accused Vikas Trivedi.
There is nothing on record to show that any amount is being credited to the account of accused-applicant.

The applicant is languishing in jail since 07.06.2024.
6.
As such, the bail application is allowed.

Let the accused-applicant,Prakhar Sharma Alias Sagarinvolved in above mentioned case crime number be enlarged on bail subject to furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.

Order Date :- 10.6.2025 Jaswant (Avnish Saxena, J.)
